text: LXIX. 1. Pañc'; imāni bhikkhave macchariyāni. Katamāni pañca? 2. Āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca macchariyāni. 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ macchariyānaṃ pahānāya . . . cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā ti. [page 460] 460 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. LXX. 1-LXXI. 4
